disposition_reason: Pb, Cr, Cd, Cu, Zn and Ni were measured by AAS in carrot, cucumber, pineapple, watermelon and orange from five Lagos markets, with means per produce type and per market.

study.design: Market survey of five produce types bought in triplicate from five Lagos markets, with proximate analysis
study.market: Oyingbo, Iyana-Ipaja, Iyana-Iba, Agboju and Ketu markets, Lagos State, Nigeria
study.method: Oven drying 35 °C; HCl/HNO3/H2SO4 Kjeldahl digestion; AAS (210/211 VGP)
study.qa: Reagent blank and replicate digestions; no CRM or recovery reported
